name: USS Enterprise (CVAN-65) as built, 1962-1964

published.source: en.wikipedia 'USS Enterprise (CVN-65)': length 1,123 ft (342.3 m) overall, 1,040 ft (317 m) waterline, beam 132.8 ft (40.5 m) waterline, 257.2 ft (78.4 m) extreme, draught 39 ft (11.9 m)

reference_notes: No reference picture is stored with this spec, so no outline is gated. The model (js/hero/us_enterprise_cvn65.js header) was measured off these Wikimedia Commons files, named there in full: [D1] 'USS Enterprise (CVN-65) deck plan, in 1999.png' (the only scale drawing: deck outline, lifts, catapults, pendants, x from the 342.3 m length, y from the 78.4 m extreme width); [P1] 'USS Enterprise (CVAN-65) at Guantanamo in February 1962' (starboard, lifts, island station, quarter sponson); [P2] '... rounds Cape Horn on 17 September 1964' (port broadside: deck height 19.0 m, island heights); [P3] '... underway on 10 April 1962 (USN 1063070)' (dead ahead: island face, bridle horns); [P4] 'Island of USS Enterprise (CVAN-65), in 1963-1964 (NNAM.1996.488.125.038)' (island close-up, SCANFAR, beehive).
A future builder with the deck plan in specs/ref/nato_e60_carrier/ can add it as a 'top' reference (px_per_m from the 342.3 m length) and gate the plan outline.
must_show: long narrow hull under a 342 m flight deck, x -171.1 .. 171.1 (bridle horns), deck top z 19.0, W/L about 0.23 [D1, P2]
angled deck at 9 deg to port, its forward corner standing out to y +42.8 at x 27.7 .. 63.4 [D1]

four deck-edge lifts: three to starboard at x -92 .. -68, -24.4 .. -0.3, 24.4 .. 48.9 (outer edge y -35.6) and one to port at x -118.4 .. -93 (outer edge y +41), each with the hangar opening under it [D1, P1]
four catapults: two up the bow to x 164, two in the waist on the angled deck [D1, P3]
square island at x -47.8, y -23.8 (37 per cent of the length from the stern): a 14 m base column z 19 .. 26.6 under an overhanging 22 m radar box z 26.6 .. 35 [P3, P4]
SCANFAR: on each face of the box one square SPS-33 array (7.0 x 7.6 m) and one wide SPS-32 array (13 x 6.4 m), pinwheel fashion, z 27 .. 34.6 [P4]
two raked window tiers z 35 .. 40 wider than the box forward and to starboard, the open top at z 40 with dark screens [P3, P4]
the conical beehive z 41 .. 51.6 with four rows of dipole arms and two piping radome rings, the mast to z 60.2 with a 25 m yard at z 55 and a dome at the head z 61.35 [P3, P4]
two bridle-arrester horns jutting from the bow at y +8.8 and -7.2 to x 171.1 [P3]

flared bow with the stem raked 12 m behind the deck front (x 152 at the waterline), square transom at x -166 under the after overhang, long empty starboard quarter sponson at x -138 .. -97, z 11.6 [P1, P2]

catwalks, safety nets on outrigger frames and life-raft canister racks along the deck edge; deck-edge whips on hinge blocks on the starboard catwalk at x -140, -62, -36, 22 and the tall pole at x -30 [P1, P3]
no guns and no missile launchers anywhere on x -171 .. 171: she commissioned with none (Wikipedia)
